title: Allow Manager Pool Deploys When Branches Are Aligned
specification:
# PRD: Allow Manager Pool Deploys When Branches Are Aligned

Priority: high

## Problem
Managers cannot queue a deploy from the manager pool when `dev` and `main` are aligned because the UI only exposes deploy actions when deployment changes are pending, even though rerunning the deploy hook can still be useful.

## Goal
Expose a manager-only deploy button that can always queue a deploy for a manageable repo, including when `dev` and `main` are aligned, without changing project UI deploy behavior.

## Requirements
- Add a deploy action to the manager repo pool/card UI for repos the session can manage.
- Show the deploy action even when `deployment.branchesAligned=true`, `hasChanges=false`, and `deployable=false`.
- Reuse existing deploy job queueing and button busy/queued/running states.
- Keep project UI deploy buttons gated by existing deployment-change logic.
- Do not mark aligned repos as deployable in dashboard counts unless product explicitly wants the metric renamed or redefined.
- Preserve read-only session blocking through existing lifecycle access checks.

## Acceptance Criteria
- On `/manager`, an aligned repo still shows an enabled deploy button labeled like `Deploy dev to main` when no deploy job is queued or running.
- Clicking the manager deploy button queues the existing `/api/repos/:repoId/deploy` job.
- While queueing, queued, or running, the manager deploy button reflects the existing busy/disabled state.
- On `/project/:repoId`, aligned repos still do not show the deploy button unless the existing project rules would show it.
- Dashboard deployable repo count remains based on actual pending branch changes unless separately changed.

## Verification
- Run `npm run typecheck`.
- Add or update focused unit/UI coverage for manager card deploy visibility when branches are aligned.
- Add or update coverage proving project card/main deploy actions remain hidden for aligned branches.
- Smoke-check manager deploy queue behavior against the existing control-plane deploy endpoint.
